TR-1.shift: pinion charts exchanged; torques that close the whole face (examples leave it open)

TR-2.shift: the wheel's charts exchanged (pending: the pinion's); end relief at the datum end

TR-4.shift: pinion charts exchanged on an overhung pinion (pending: straddle mounted)

TR-5.shift: the wheel's charts exchanged; the widest face and the highest torques
